title: Platform Isolation Contract (Naukri vs LinkedIn)
rule_statement: Changes, fixes, or enhancements targeting Naukri must never touch, break, or mutate LinkedIn automation files, and vice versa. Each platform maintains isolated handlers, scrapers, and data models.
user_quotes: The agent currently works for 2 websites naukr and linkedin, whenever user asks/demands to change/edit/upgrade any py script you have to ensure that the change for naukri should not affect the functioning of linkedin since scraping/answering of questions/form tags/htm tags/structure etx all the immp things of website are diff, and vis versa....
enforcement_mechanism: Strict file boundary checks separating Naukri scripts (02_*, naukri_*) from LinkedIn scripts (03_*, linkedin_*).
